name: Sort products by price low to high
goal: Log in as 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce'. On the Products page, use the sort dropdown to sort by 'Price (low to high)'.
expected: Products are listed in ascending price order; the cheapest item (Sauce Labs Onesie, $7.99) is first.

name: Remove item from cart
goal: Log in as 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce'. Add 'Sauce Labs Bike Light' to the cart, open the cart, then remove the item.
expected: The cart page is empty (no items listed).

name: Scroll to footer and find social links
goal: Log in as 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce'. Scroll down to the bottom of the Products page.
expected: The footer is visible showing Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn links and a copyright line mentioning Sauce Labs.

name: Logout via menu
goal: Log in as 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', open the hamburger menu, and click Logout.
expected: User is returned to the login page.

name: Visual bugs with problem_user
goal: Log in as 'problem_user' / 'secret_sauce' and inspect the Products page.
expected: Every product shows its own correct product image (a backpack, a bike light, etc. matching the product names) with no visual defects.
